sources.summary: Chinese interior designer Bin Wu's book Timeless East explores the idea of a design language rooted in the philosophical context of the East. For this roundup, he picks six of his own favourite projects in China and abroad. The Design Language of Timeless East features 17 projects completed by Wu and his studio W Design, The post Six projects from Bin Wu that showcase design "articulated by the East itself" appeared first on Dezeen .
